cs.t: Those tiny HDMI monitors are soooooo useful in so many situations, especially if they do pass-through. I like  https://feelworld.ltd/collections/5-6-inch-camera-monitor/pr...  or similar, $100. I use it for projection - then I can run the projector as a second monitor through this thing (or similar) and not have to use binoculars to see what's on the screen from the back of the room. Larger ones can be used as portable second monitors, too.
cs.th: Using a laptop as an HDMI monitor for an SBC

cs.t: Try "camera field monitor." Example:  https://www.amazon.com/FEELWORLD-Monitor-1280x720-Peaking-In...  I used one of these to make a teleprompter-style videoconference setup at home during the pandemic, so I could make eye contact with other meeting participants.
cs.th: $2 WeAct Display FS adds a 0.96-inch USB information display to your computer
